title: Ceiling-planned sessions: cost vs the default hybrid

constants.margin_rule: m = 0.059 unless the STAT-1 L90 margin is larger; (1-m) multiplies the memory ceiling of resident configs only; W-512 is exact

M1_prior.basis: code/doc text only: tools/run_h1_hybrid.py:1483-1484, 1658; DEMO2_AMEND_2026-10-16_TRUE_DEFAULT.md lines 138-148
M1_prior.status: unverified until the M1 two-call probe

controls.D1: OpenVINO GenAI LLMPipeline(model,'GPU') true default (i8 read-back, unchunked, 57%, W 40,960); residency AS MEASURED BY M1; local-first; on exception or no first token within 10 s -> cancel, re-issue to cloud with full transcript and cache_control on the stable prefix; sticky; 0 local retries
controls.D2: D1 + pre-call check: Qwen3 tokens + max_new > declared window -> cloud, sticky; declared window runtime-reported (OpenVINO 40,960; Ollama num_ctx via /api/show); margin 0 primary, 0.05 sensitivity
controls.ROUTE-1: session-start config from the set maximizing predicted local turns s.t. k*n_ctx + a*min(n_new,c) <= B_eff*(1-m); n_ctx + max_new <= W-512; predicted TTFT <= 10 s; passed COST-1 X-Q; tie-break toward the default; planned migration = first t with predicted C_t > min(L_session, W-512)*(1-m) (margin on the memory term only); delta-hat re-estimated each turn; per-call guard; one cloud tier per session; transcript handoff
controls.Oracle: perfect per-turn feasibility, TTFT and cache state; minimizes $ with no failure and no SLO miss; Y = (D - ROUTE-1)/(D - Oracle), D = control with the smaller saving

ablations.A0: HYB-1 P2-U guard at default config
ablations.A1: D1 on ROUTE-1's config, no predictor
A3: B-rand seed 20261031 at ROUTE-1's cloud share

H-R0.prediction: cloud $ differ by <= 2%; failed local attempts >= 95% fewer

H-R1.contrast: ROUTE-1 vs min(D1, D2), Sonnet, sessions crossing 19,750

decision_rules.DR-R2: H-R1 holds, H-R7 fails -> headline only as rework-adjusted $; under 10% -> no dollar headline, lead with failures and time
decision_rules.DR-R3: branch R -> 'Zero failed attempts and planned migration at 5-8% lower $'; [private]
decision_rules.DR-R4: H-R3 holds -> say the dollars come from the configuration the model selects
decision_rules.DR-R5: live billed $ misses +/-10% -> live numbers carry the headline; simulator exploratory
decision_rules.DR-R6: COST-1 X-Q <= 26/30 -> drop u4; use i8-c256 + resident (38,000, 1e9671a0); base edge ~30% (DERIVED $165.10)
